text: A very special island is inhabited only by angels and devils. Angels always tell the truth, and devils always lie. You meet 2 inhabitants: Zoey, and Liam. Zoey said, "Liam is a devil." Liam asserted: "Zoey is a devil if and only if Liam is an angel". So who is an angel and who is a devil? (Format your answer like: "Zoey is a angel/devil, and Liam is a angel/devil")
